subject.description: New subject line for the email

preview_text.description: New preview text shown in email clients before the email is opened

content.description: New HTML body content of the email

delay_unit.description: New delay unit. Use `days` for schedule-aware delivery, `hours` for a fixed hourly delay

email_template_id.description: New email template ID for layout and styling. Pass `null` to clear

published.description: Pass `true` to publish a draft email or `false` to unpublish it

send_days.description: Days of the week this email may be sent. Pass a subset to restrict delivery, or `null` to reset to all days (inherits the sequence schedule)

position.description: New zero-based position of the email in the sequence
